evidence.excerpt:
32: - **MOP:** Definitions 5-6, p. 5 / PDF 8, and the restatement of Definition 5, p. 28 / PDF 31, mean decidability of membership in each trained generator's positive-probability support. Definition 6 literally quantifies over each history before asserting decidability. It does not explicitly assert a joint selector of deciders from histories. Surrounding source reductions that compute using MOP suggest a uniform operational reading; that suggestion is not a literal extra hypothesis.
33: - **Token generation:** Definition 15, p. 30 / PDF 33, uses a randomized next-token machine, auxiliary information, and an EOS stop. It halts on every input. Section 6.1, p. 58 / PDF 61, clarifies all realizations of its random bits and explicitly notes that the overall token process need not halt.
34: - **Stability and relaxations:** Definitions 7-8, p. 32 / PDF 35, require eventual equality of support sets on each enumeration, and strict symmetric-difference closeness to the target versus every distinct competitor. Cardinalities can be infinite. The displayed statistical “error” on that same page is literally the indicator of this *success* comparison. Definition 9 and Equation (6), p. 33 / PDF 36, require support contained in `K`, with only finitely many omissions; their error is the indicator of failure of that property. No quantitative bound on the finite omitted set is given.

53: 源文印刷 p.21 / PDF 24 明确授予按 `(index,string)` 查询的 family membership oracle；Definition 11（p.22 / PDF 25）另给 tell-tale enumeration oracle，并强调它对算法的重要性。p.25 / PDF 28 又称学习器为 computable 映射序列。综合这些语境，不能要求所有 oracle 都无条件普通可计算，再把 Lean 相对程序误判为错误。
